methods.description: Follow the arrows: the source has no incoming edges and the sink no outgoing edges, whatever their positions.
Read an edge weight as its maximum movement rate in the arrow direction, distinguish it from actual flow, and use equal inflow/outflow at an intermediate vertex where nothing is stored or added.
Add only capacities entering or leaving the stated vertex. Compare totals if asked; source/sink totals give upper limits, not actual flow or a determination of maximum flow.
Check whether every source-to-sink path crosses the line; an avoiding path shows that the line is not a cut.
